os.path.realpath resolves a relative path against the CURRENT WORKING DIRECTORY, so "work/live_ab/sandbox.lock" compared EQUAL to canonical when cwd was the repo root. A lock whose identity depends on where the process started is not host-wide. Found by an actual-entry test; the source-string assertion it replaced could never have found it.

repairs.change: the serialized SPELLING is constrained, not just the resolved path
repairs.detail: <WORK>/sandbox.lock resolves to the canonical file in the owner checkout and elsewhere in a clone. Only the canonical token or the canonical absolute path are admissible. This is an ADDITIONAL requirement, never an exemption.

repairs.change: a job-carried host root must AGREE with the audited module pin

repairs.detail: tests patch lab_common._HARNESS_CONFIG so the canonical root is a temp dir; production is unchanged and still validates. CLI tests use the canonical spelling because the errors they exercise occur after the lock check.

"A path or flag cannot designate itself an isolated fixture."
